fills.en: Mr. Hughes ___ a voicemail for Ms. Carter about an hour ago.
fills.zh: 大約一個小時前，Hughes 先生留了一則語音留言給 Carter 小姐。
fills.note: 有 an hour ago，用過去式；完成式不能接 ago。

fills.en: All warehouse workers ___ to wear gloves near the machinery.
fills.zh: 所有倉庫員工在機器附近都必須戴手套。
fills.note: 員工是「被要求」，用被動式 are required to。

fills.en: Would you mind ___ the agenda to everyone before the meeting?
fills.zh: 可以麻煩你在開會前把議程寄給大家嗎？
fills.note: mind 後面接動名詞 V-ing。

fills.en: Ms. Lin ___ in the purchasing department since 2023.
fills.zh: 林小姐從 2023 年起就一直在採購部工作。
fills.note: since 表示一直到現在，用現在完成式。

fills.en: Ms. Carter asked me to send ___ the final version of the report.
fills.zh: Carter 小姐請我把報告的最終版寄給她。
fills.note: send 後面接受格 her。

fills.en: This hotel is ___ than the one we stayed at last year.
fills.zh: 這家飯店比我們去年住的那家方便。
fills.note: 後面有 than，用比較級。

fills.en: Warehouse staff must count the boxes ___ before each shipment leaves.
fills.zh: 每批貨出發前，倉庫人員都必須準確清點箱子。
fills.note: 修飾動詞 count，要用副詞。

fills.en: We need Ms. Carter's ___ before we can order the new printers.
fills.zh: 我們要先得到 Carter 小姐的核准，才能訂購新的印表機。
fills.note: 所有格後面接名詞 approval（核准）。

fills.en: Because of the storm, the airline changed the ___ time of our flight.
fills.zh: 因為暴風雨，航空公司更改了我們班機的起飛時間。
fills.note: departure time 是「起飛時間」。

fills.en: Please ___ your expense report to the accounting department by Friday.
fills.zh: 請在星期五以前把你的費用報告交給會計部。
fills.note: submit ... to 是「把⋯⋯交給」。

fills.en: The conference room is free ___ two and four this afternoon.
fills.zh: 會議室今天下午兩點到四點之間是空的。
fills.note: between A and B：在 A 和 B 之間。

fills.en: The shipment arrived two days late, ___ the customer was still satisfied.
fills.zh: 貨晚了兩天才到，但客戶還是很滿意。
fills.note: 前後意思相反（晚到，卻滿意），用 but。

fills.en: A technician ___ the printer on the third floor yesterday afternoon.
fills.zh: 昨天下午有一位技術人員修好了三樓的印表機。
fills.note: 有 yesterday，用過去式 fixed。

fills.en: Refreshments for tomorrow's meeting ___ by a caterer.
fills.zh: 明天會議的茶點會由外燴業者提供。
fills.note: 茶點是「被提供」，用未來被動式。

fills.en: Ms. Carter has decided ___ the team meeting until next Tuesday.
fills.zh: Carter 小姐決定把團隊會議延到下星期二。
fills.note: decide 後面接 to + 原形動詞。

fills.en: We ___ a reply from the supplier since Monday.
fills.zh: 從星期一到現在，我們都還沒收到廠商的回覆。
fills.note: since 表示一直到現在，用現在完成式。

fills.en: Mr. Grant called to say the replacement lamp finally reached ___ this morning.
fills.zh: Grant 先生打電話來說，換貨的檯燈今天早上終於送到他那裡了。
fills.note: reach 後面接受格 him。

fills.en: Our booth was one of the ___ booths at the trade fair.
fills.zh: 我們的攤位是商展上最受歡迎的攤位之一。
fills.note: one of the 後面接最高級。

fills.en: The receptionist explained the hotel rules very ___.
fills.zh: 櫃檯人員把飯店規定解釋得很清楚。
fills.note: 修飾動詞 explained，要用副詞。

fills.en: Please send us written ___ of your order before we start production.
fills.zh: 在我們開始生產之前，請寄給我們訂單的書面確認。
fills.note: 形容詞 written 後面接名詞。

fills.en: Guests can leave their ___ at the front desk after checkout.
fills.zh: 房客退房後可以把行李寄放在櫃檯。
fills.note: 退房後寄放在櫃檯的是行李。

fills.en: Before you sign the agreement, please ___ that all the prices are correct.
fills.zh: 在簽合約之前，請確認所有價格都正確。
fills.note: verify that ... 是「確認⋯⋯」。

fills.en: The supplier agreed to deliver the goods ___ ten days of our order.
fills.zh: 廠商同意在我們下單後十天內交貨。
fills.note: within ten days of：⋯⋯後十天內。

fills.en: We will send your refund ___ we receive the item you returned.
fills.zh: 我們收到您退回的商品之後，就會把退款寄給您。
fills.note: 先收到退貨再退款，用 after。

textFills.title: Change to Thursday's meeting
lines: Thursday's sales meeting has been ___ to Friday at 10 a.m., because Ms. Carter will be at the trade fair on Thursday.
We will meet in Room 3 instead of the conference room. ___
Because of this, please print your slides and bring ten copies of ___.
zh: 星期四的業務會議已經延到星期五上午十點，因為 Carter 小姐星期四會在商展。
我們會在三號會議室開會，不在大會議室。可惜三號會議室沒有投影機。
因此，請把你的投影片印出來，帶十份來。

options: The trade fair opens at nine on Thursday morning.
The conference room has a new projector.
Unfortunately, it does not have a projector.
Lunch will be provided after the meeting.
blanks.note: it 指 Room 3；沒投影機，所以要印出來。
介系詞 of 後面接受格 them。

textFills.title: New rule for fragile goods
lines: From Monday, March 3, all fragile goods must be wrapped in plastic and ___ with a red label.
If you cannot find them, please ask Mr. Lopez ___ you start packing.
Thank you for helping us prevent damage.
zh: 從三月三日星期一起，所有易碎品都必須用塑膠包好，並貼上紅色標籤。
標籤放在二號碼頭旁邊的架子上。
如果找不到，請在開始打包前先問 Lopez 先生。
謝謝大家一起幫忙避免貨物損壞。

blanks.note: be wrapped and marked，兩個都是被動。

options: The labels are kept on the shelf next to Dock 2.
Last month, two boxes of glass arrived broken.
The truck for Mr. Hughes's order leaves at three.
Our warehouse is closed on Sundays.
blanks.note: 下一句的 them 指標籤放的地方。

textFills.title: Re: Your coffee machine
lines: I am very sorry that the coffee machine you ordered from us arrived ___.
We will send you a new one on Thursday. ___
Please give him the broken machine so that he can return it to us.
zh: 很抱歉，您向我們訂購的咖啡機送到時已經損壞。
我們星期四會寄一台新的給您。我們的司機會在早上送到您的辦公室。
請把壞掉的咖啡機交給他，讓他帶回來給我們。
造成您的不便，再次向您致歉。
客服部 Wong 小姐 敬上

options: The machine comes with a guarantee.
You will also receive a coupon for your next order.
I ordered it from our supplier this morning.
Our driver will bring it to your office in the morning.
blanks.note: 下一句的 him、he 指司機。

textFills.title: Holiday party
lines: Our holiday party will be held at the Grand Hall on Friday, December 12, ___ 6:30 p.m.
There will be a buffet dinner, live music and a short award ceremony. ___
If you would like to bring someone, please ___ Ms. Carter know by Monday.
zh: 我們的年末派對將在十二月十二日星期五晚上六點半，於 Grand Hall 舉行。
現場有自助餐、現場音樂和簡短的頒獎典禮。今年每位員工也可以帶一位來賓。
如果你想帶人來，請在星期一以前告訴 Carter 小姐。

options: This year, each member of staff may also bring one guest.
Please do not bring any food or drinks.
The winners will receive their prizes on stage.
The Grand Hall is a short walk from our office.
blanks.note: 先說可以帶來賓，才接「想帶人來」。
please 後接原形：let someone know。
